Population increased in Rhondda Cynon Taf

The estimated population of Rhondda Cynon Taf in 2024 was 242,844 usual residents, a rise of 0.3% since 2023.

This meant that Rhondda Cynon Taf's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Rhondda Cynon Taf increased by 2.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Rhondda Cynon Taf was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Rhondda Cynon Taf

The average (median) age rose to 41.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Rhondda Cynon Taf has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Rhondda Cynon Taf is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Rhondda Cynon Taf's population of 242,844 usual residents was made up of:

  • 42,992 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.7%)
  • 151,290 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.3%)
  • 48,562 people aged 65 years and over, (20%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Rhondda Cynon Taf has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (20% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Rhondda Cynon Taf, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Rhondda Cynon Taf
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Rhondda Cynon Taf, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 653 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 2,162 births and 2,815 deaths in Rhondda Cynon Taf.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 466 (-0.2%). There were 7,265 people entering the area and 7,731 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Rhondda Cynon Taf's population of 1,863 (0.8%) as a result of 2,535 people entering the area and 672 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Rhondda Cynon Taf was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Rhondda Cynon Taf in mid-2023 is 242,091.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 645 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 268 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 913 people.
